summary.learning_goal: Follow a massive star from fuel-supported equilibrium through collapse to an event horizon and accretion light.
summary.primary_visualization: Eight staged stellar and black-hole scenes alongside short explanations.
summary.primary_interaction: Demo advances through chapters; no physical parameter manipulation verified.

strengths: Collapse text distinguishes possible ejection, fallback and stars fading without a brilliant supernova.
weaknesses: No independent physics audit or quantitative scale; the video cannot establish the scientific validity of its rendering.

strengths: The same focal object progresses from star to collapse to horizon with one short explanation per stage.
weaknesses: The shown journey remains guided and passive; no prediction, parameter comparison or synthesis was demonstrated.

strengths: Shrinking core and surrounding ejection make temporal transformation visible; horizon and luminous disk have distinct visual states.
weaknesses: Lensing appearance is illustrative; dramatic glow could obscure the distinction between physical geometry and apparent image.

strengths: Chapter controls provide a visible route through distinct conceptual states.
weaknesses: Only video navigation is evidenced; no direct causal manipulation, responsiveness or keyboard behavior was tested.

strengths: Stable left explanation, dominant right scene and compact bottom chapter rail maintain hierarchy throughout the demo.
weaknesses: Small secondary labels and dark low-contrast copy may be hard to read; mobile and accessible navigation unverified.

top_strengths: One concept and matching scene per chapter
Exceptionally coherent scene and typography composition
principles_to_learn: Keep a continuous object as the narrative changes its state.
Place concise explanations beside the corresponding transformation.
Use a chapter rail to show both progress and the whole conceptual sequence.
Label illustrative timing and alternate physical outcomes.
things_not_to_copy: Do not copy a cinematic sequence as a substitute for learner control.
Do not present lensing artwork as a quantitatively validated simulation.
golden_recommendation: Provisional demo reference. Use for chapter storytelling. Live behavior remains unverified.
